A6_FVAL_delta.whyNotSilentWeakening: The current configured-maxima guarantee that every hypothetical input-quota-sized task fits is deliberately changed, not claimed preserved. Proposed definition instead explicitly defines effective input admission as intersection of two quotas. Actual bounded task safety, full compilation coverage and source evidence are retained; smaller quota rejects oversized or incomplete work, never deletes lenses/files/relations or silently caps measured input to manufacture success. Grant/resource selection and catalog/package/source/prepared identities unchanged. User approval and fresh A6/F-VAL reviewer disposition required before implementation; if they require original worst-case configured-maxima relation, retain it and mark independent context effect impossible instead.
A6_FVAL_delta.actualControls: all87 complete preserved/A/B target definition positives, per-task small A positive and measured task A reject/B admit, unchanged runtime helper B positive plus oversized same helper negative; current resolver context A/B rejection separately recorded
A6_FVAL_delta.futureRequired: actual admitted full compiler/stage source/coverage and exact retained grant/target identities; over-budget rejects before Core effect admission; mutation removing measured-input guard must fail; historical/current source math does not satisfy future behavioral gate

targetProposed.externalLimits: Source/schema controls use declared isolated target limits to prove type/relation definitions and existing arithmetic only. Actual deployed/installed model/runtime/operator profiles are unknown; live compatible activation requires exact real inputs, not invented model capacity or attestation string.

A6_FVAL_delta.whyNotSilentWeakening: The current configured-maxima guarantee that every hypothetical input-quota-sized task fits is deliberately changed, not claimed preserved. Proposed definition instead explicitly defines effective input admission as intersection of two quotas. Actual bounded task safety, full compilation coverage and source evidence are retained; smaller quota rejects oversized or incomplete work, never deletes lenses/files/relations or silently caps measured input to manufacture success. Grant/resource selection and catalog/package/source/prepared identities unchanged. User approval and fresh A6/F-VAL reviewer disposition required before implementation; if they require original worst-case configured-maxima relation, retain it and mark independent context effect impossible instead.
A6_FVAL_delta.actualControls: all87 complete preserved/A/B target definition positives, per-task small A positive and measured task A reject/B admit, unchanged runtime helper B positive plus oversized same helper negative; current resolver context A/B rejection separately recorded
A6_FVAL_delta.futureRequired: actual admitted full compiler/stage source/coverage and exact retained grant/target identities; over-budget rejects before Core effect admission; mutation removing measured-input guard must fail; historical/current source math does not satisfy future behavioral gate

targetProposed.externalLimits: Source/schema controls use declared isolated target limits to prove type/relation definitions and existing arithmetic only. Actual deployed/installed model/runtime/operator profiles are unknown; live compatible activation requires exact real inputs, not invented model capacity or attestation string.

A6_FVAL_delta.whyNotSilentWeakening: The current configured-maxima guarantee that every hypothetical input-quota-sized task fits is deliberately changed, not claimed preserved. Proposed definition instead explicitly defines effective input admission as intersection of two quotas. Actual bounded task safety, full compilation coverage and source evidence are retained; smaller quota rejects oversized or incomplete work, never deletes lenses/files/relations or silently caps measured input to manufacture success. Grant/resource selection and catalog/package/source/prepared identities unchanged. User approval and fresh A6/F-VAL reviewer disposition required before implementation; if they require original worst-case configured-maxima relation, retain it and mark independent context effect impossible instead.
A6_FVAL_delta.actualControls: all87 complete preserved/A/B target definition positives, per-task small A positive and measured task A reject/B admit, unchanged runtime helper B positive plus oversized same helper negative; current resolver context A/B rejection separately recorded
A6_FVAL_delta.futureRequired: actual admitted full compiler/stage source/coverage and exact retained grant/target identities; over-budget rejects before Core effect admission; mutation removing measured-input guard must fail; historical/current source math does not satisfy future behavioral gate

targetProposed.externalLimits: Source/schema controls use declared isolated target limits to prove type/relation definitions and existing arithmetic only. Actual deployed/installed model/runtime/operator profiles are unknown; live compatible activation requires exact real inputs, not invented model capacity or attestation string.
